title: At times like these - go to Walmart!!
text:
I ordered the Multi-cat box! I have five cats - 2 seniors, 1 young adult, and 2 off-the-wall teenagers!! The box came in and the kittens were pawing at it. However, the new normal is that you wait, wash or spray the sucker down to keep COVID-19 at bay!! They didn't care - "give me what is inside this box or we will take it"!!
Cute - as a gift it is wonderful, but 5 toys and a small bag of Wellness cat treat for the price - no!
Amazon should check the items for themselves - you have pets. I do not believe it is worth 25USD.

Walmart or even Target - 25USD worth will be - cat toys plus a bag of Blue cat treats and large bag of catnip - and you might get change!!

thanks for reading!!
label: negative
